components.name: Engine
components.description: Primary power-producing unit of the vehicle.

components.name: Transmission
components.description: Transfers engine or motor power through selectable or variable gear ratios.

components.name: Transfer Case
components.description: Distributes power between front and rear axles in applicable four-wheel-drive systems.

components.name: Propeller Shaft
components.description: Transfers rotational power between the transmission, transfer case, and driven axle where applicable.

components.name: Driveshaft
components.description: Rotating shaft that transfers power to a driven axle or wheel assembly.

components.name: Differential
components.description: Allows driven wheels on the same axle to rotate at different speeds while transmitting torque.

components.name: Front Differential
components.description: Differential assembly used on the front driven axle.

components.name: Rear Differential
components.description: Differential assembly used on the rear driven axle.

components.name: CV Axle
components.description: Constant-velocity axle assembly that transfers power to a driven wheel while allowing suspension and steering movement.

components.name: CV Joint
components.description: Constant-velocity joint that allows power transmission through changing shaft angles.

components.name: Axle Shaft
components.description: Shaft that transfers torque from the differential to the driven wheel assembly.

components.name: Half Shaft
components.description: Drive axle shaft connecting a differential or transaxle to an individual driven wheel.

components.name: Wheel Hub Assembly
components.description: Wheel mounting assembly that may include bearings and wheel-speed sensing components.

components.name: Drivetrain Bearing
components.description: Bearing used to support rotating drivetrain components.

components.name: Clutch
components.description: Mechanical coupling used to engage or disengage engine power from a manual or applicable automated transmission.

components.name: Torque Converter
components.description: Fluid coupling used in conventional automatic transmissions to transfer engine torque.

components.name: Transmission Fluid
components.description: Specialized fluid used for lubrication, cooling, and hydraulic operation in applicable transmissions.

components.name: Electric Drive Motor
components.description: Electric motor used to provide propulsion in hybrid or electric vehicles.

components.name: Reduction Gear
components.description: Gear reduction unit used to deliver appropriate speed and torque from an electric drive motor.

components.name: Unknown
components.description: Drivetrain component information has not yet been verified.
